summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in their opening match of the season, with Saul Shotton grabbing a late consolation goal but unable to prevent a disappointing result that saw the team rue missed chances and defensive lapses. The Bach will look to bounce back this Saturday at home against promotion-chasing Stafford Town, a team they'll need to be at their absolute best against. Fans are encouraged to get behind the side and create a great atmosphere as the team looks to get their campaign back on track.
